verdict.rationale: Cekura has a broad programmatic surface: a published OpenAPI spec, an API reference covering call ingestion and API-key management, sync/async SDKs, and a CLI that manages agents, scenarios, runs and call data. Nothing in the evidence states or shows that every UI capability is exposed through the API. Missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement, evidence that UI features like dashboards, PII redaction settings, cron jobs and A/B comparisons are API-accessible, independent hands-on confirmation of API coverage.
